## About
Hillco Auto & Truck Repair is a locally owned and operated shop on S Broadway in South St. Louis. The technicians here work on everything from drivetrain to engine repair, on cars and trucks alike.
Reviewers often mention Stan by name, and one traveling family thanked both Stan and Jim for helping them sort out a Jeep breakdown while they were passing through town. We hold a 4.7 rating on Google from 49 reviews.
If your vehicle needs work, give us a call or come by the shop during the week.

## Services
- Computer diagnostics: Tracking down warning lights, electrical problems and hard-to-find issues.
- Brakes, shocks and struts: Brake work and suspension repair to keep your ride steady and stopping right.
- A/C and heating: Repairs for your vehicle's air conditioning and heat.
- Drivetrain and engine repair: Our technicians handle the big jobs, from drivetrain to engine work.
- Commercial fleet maintenance and repair: Scheduled maintenance and repairs to keep your business vehicles on the road.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM, and closed Saturday and Sunday.

Q: Do you work on trucks?
A: Yes. We repair cars and trucks alike.

Q: Can you take care of my company's vehicles?
A: Yes. We offer maintenance and repairs for commercial fleets.

## What customers say
- "We were traveling through St. Louis on vacation with our RV towing our Jeep when our Jeep blew an axle seal and destroyed the bearing.  We stopped at Hillco Auto & Truck Repair to ask for help. Unfortunately, due to the damage from the imploded bearing and the Jeep’s modifications (lift, long arms…) they did not feel that they had the resources to assist us.  They made several phone calls to try to find assistance and when we found someone who could help, Hillco arranged for the Jeep to be towed.  They refused to bill us for the time spent diagnosing and helping us.  They just wished us well on our trip.   This is the type of shop we all want to do business with.
